verdict.line: You win the all-in windows between levels 3 and 8 when Q and E land clean, but you lose the game if it drags past level 9 and Malphite's armor stacking turns Ground Slam and Unstoppable Force into a scaling threat.

brief.thesis: Irelia has the trading tools to punish Malphite in short bursts — Q (Bladesurge) resets off an E (Flawless Duet) mark, letting her chain a stun into a reset dash before Granite Shield fully recharges. But Malphite's kit gets better with time: Brutal Strikes buffs his armor and AD, and Ground Slam's damage scales off that same armor, so every level he survives makes the next trade worse for you. The 43.8% win rate over 2010 games reflects a lane that starts in your favor and slips away if you don't close it out.

theirWindow.what: With his passive shield charged and Ground Slam (7s cooldown) available, Malphite can poke with Seismic Shard and punish your engage with an attack speed slow that stalls your passive Ionian Fervor stacks. Don't force a fight here — bait the shockwave with a minion or your Q dash onto a minion before committing.

yourWindow.what: The moment Ground Slam is down you have a clean 7-second window where his attack speed slow and armor shred aren't in play. Walk in behind minion aggro to pop Granite Shield, then Q (Bladesurge) into E (Flawless Duet) for the stun — the Q refreshes instantly off the E mark, so you get a second dash-strike before he can respond.

start.why: Picked in 86% of games (43.5% win rate, 2073 games) because the lifesteal offsets Seismic Shard poke while you're walking up to trade.

boots.why: 63.9% pick rate at 46.2% win rate — the magic resist cuts down Ground Slam's armor-scaled damage, and the tenacity shortens how long Unstoppable Force's knockup keeps you locked down.

core.why: On-hit damage and the active slow let you finish a target that tries to walk out of your Q-E stun chain before Granite Shield resets.
Highest-picked second item (24.4% pick, 53.9% win rate in this path) — rewards the split-push angle Irelia takes once the lane stabilizes past level 9.
Magic resist directly answers Ground Slam and Unstoppable Force, both magic damage, while adding more attack speed for passive stacking.

situational.when: you're getting bursted down in all-ins and need the damage delay plus healing to win extended trades
the game is snowballing and you want raw burst over sustain to close out kills before Granite Shield recharges
their team splits evenly between physical and magic damage and you need the adaptive resistance

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping adaptive damage and healing reward the extended trades this matchup produces once you're past Granite Shield, offsetting how tanky Malphite becomes as he stacks armor.

summoners.why: The most played combo into Malphite (69.3% pick, 44.3% win rate) — Ignite punishes his early sustain and passive shield regen during your level 3-5 all-in window. Flash+Teleport (41.6% win rate, 18.2% pick) is the better pick if you expect the game to drag into the scaling window where he takes over.

playing.title: Track Ground Slam's 7-second cooldown
playing.detail: Engage only when it's down — the attack speed slow it applies otherwise stalls your Ionian Fervor stacks and kills your trade.

playing.title: Don't eat Seismic Shard closing in
playing.detail: It steals movement speed on top of its damage, so the trade you're walking into is already worse by the time you arrive.

playing.title: Chain Q into E for the reset
playing.detail: Bladesurge refreshes instantly if the target is Marked by Flawless Duet or dies to it, so a landed E stun gives you a second Q dash-strike in the same fight.

playing.title: Bait Granite Shield before all-in
playing.detail: If he hasn't been hit recently, his passive shield absorbs your first hit — pop it with a minion auto or a Q onto a wave before committing your combo.

playing.title: Hold W through his Brutal Strikes window
playing.detail: Defiant Dance's charge reduces physical damage taken, so time it to survive his empowered attacks and release the strike once his buff drops.

playing.title: Stop full-committing past level 9
playing.detail: Once he's stacked armor from items and Brutal Strikes, Ground Slam's damage (based on his Armor) scales hard enough that extended skirmishes stop favoring you.

playing.title: Respect his 1000-range R after level 6
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force turns a 1v1 you're winning into a teamfight by knocking you up and dragging allies in — don't fight on flat, open angles where he has a clean line.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, and summoner data are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the win-condition reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the kit interactions, not measured stats.

stats.opponentTip: Engage combat whenever Malphite’s (E) is on cooldown. Avoid being hit with (Q) too often while closing in to deal damage.
